prerequisites: To enroll in this course, it is necessary to have passed or be enrolled in all subjects from courses prior to the one in which this subject is located.

learning_outcomes.text: To know the components of machines, their use and maintenance.
To know how to calculate the most commonly used machine elements.
To know the general aspects of machine construction and testing.
To know and be able to apply basic maintenance techniques in machines.
To be able to use and interpret the results of software used in machine design.

syllabus_topics: FUNDAMENTALS OF ODEs APPLIED TO THE DYNAMICS OF MECHANICAL SYSTEMS.
INTRODUCTION TO THE VIBRATORY BEHAVIOR OF MECHANICAL SYSTEMS.
STEADY-STATE RESPONSE TO HARMONIC FORCES OF DAMPED AND UNDAMPED 1-DOF SYSTEMS.
RESPONSE OF SYSTEMS TO UNIT IMPULSES.
RESPONSE OF 1-DOF SYSTEMS TO GENERAL LOADS.
MODAL ANALYSIS, NATURAL FREQUENCIES AND MODES.
OTHER SYSTEMS WITH MORE THAN 1 DOF.
INTRODUCTION TO THE SOLUTION OF FORCED VIBRATIONS IN SYSTEMS WITH MORE THAN 1 DOF.
PROGRAMMING OF IMPLICIT AND EXPLICIT METHODS TO MODEL THE DYNAMIC BEHAVIOR OF MECHANICAL SYSTEMS.
PROGRAMMING OF NUMERICAL METHODS IN SYSTEMS WITH MORE THAN 1 DOF.
INTRODUCTION TO NUMERICAL METHODS FOR SOLVING PARTIAL DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS.

assessment_methods.method: Practice reports, practicum and external practices

assessment_rules: The course will be passed if a final grade equal to or greater than five is obtained. Laboratory attendance, practice reports, and tutored work account for a maximum of 4 points of the final grade, which will be carried over to the second call. The remaining grade is obtained through two exercises: one on the dynamics of single-degree-of-freedom systems, and another on multi-degree-of-freedom systems. In case of unethical behavior such as copying or plagiarism, the global grade for the academic year will be a fail (0.0).
